import base64,hashlib,json,os
from pathlib import Path
owner=Path('/var/lib/fyp-owner')
old=owner/'receipt-transfer-attempt1';old.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
files={'launch-policy.json': {'base64': '', 'sha256': '80831c99b3def500b86335ef038142148f8f04025ca530e38673de2ef573e61d'}, 'receipts/REVIEW_ACCEPTED.json': {'base64': '', 'sha256': '95e337416773c6ed99cc8bc1caa82736c30ee829c606317a8837b51c4c0d1461'}, 'receipts/FREEZE.json': {'base64': '', 'sha256': '0435a37f534b8a8cde77104840c0fb81323011f7f21d93b4ebc38260a09222b2'}, 'receipts/LAUNCH.json': {'base64': '', 'sha256': '35b9d06c9676baadffd4561bf2489b2bc1b08afce28fca5f1e259657f841bcd9'}}
for name,spec in files.items():
 p=owner/name; retained=old/name;retained.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);p.rename(retained)
 raw=base64.b64decode(spec['base64'])
 if hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()!=spec['sha256']:raise ValueError('RECEIPT_TRANSPORT_DRIFT')
